question: Have the UsenetMax website and news.usenetmax.com:563 permanently stopped serving, so the free server should be recorded dead?
why: On 2026-11-25 broker reads answered HTTP 504 and 522, a direct HTTP probe failed at the transport layer and a TCP probe of port 563 got a DNS resolution failure; the 2026-11-04 probe rows in the record had already timed out, so two consecutive dates show no answer but the offer text cannot be re-read.
